provenance.post_title: Dragons That Cause Lots of Swearing
provenance.asset_description: Oath Dragon Concept, artist Kent Hamilton: A sketch design of an oath dragon, a dragon with overlapping scales that are elongated and resemble feathers. The dragon’s wings have long feather-like plumes instead of bat-like webbing.
